objective: Review the calculator for correctness edge cases and unsafe expression evaluation.

subtasks.objective: Review the calculator for correctness edge cases and unsafe expression evaluation.

plan.rationale: single agent, one prompt, all tools

findings.description: Use of eval can execute attacker-controlled Python
findings.rationale: Dynamic code execution is unsafe when any part of the expression is untrusted.
findings.suggested_fix:
return ast.literal_eval(expression)
# import ast; literal_eval accepts only Python literals. For arithmetic, parse with ast and allow only number and operator nodes.

findings.description: Division may fail when the divisor is zero
findings.rationale: The divisor is a variable and this expression does not establish a non-zero precondition.
